pick.title: Boilers found
pick.description: Pick your boiler. The PIN (on the sticker on the controller) is only needed to change settings and to update the silo on the controller.

manual.title: Connect to the boiler
manual.description: No boiler answered on the network. Enter its IP address (ip:port works too). Serial and PIN are optional.

pellets.title: Your pellets
pellets.description: Tell Burnerific about your stock so it can predict when you run out. You can change all of this later.

data.initial_storage_kg: Pellets in storage now (kg, not counting the silo)

data_description.annual_kg: A first guess for the model. It learns your real consumption within weeks.

reauth_confirm.title: New PIN needed
reauth_confirm.description: {boiler} refused the PIN. Enter the PIN from the sticker on the controller (or the one you set on its panel).

error.cannot_connect: The boiler did not answer. Check the address and that Home Assistant is on the same network.

abort.already_configured: This boiler is already set up.

data_description.stokercloud_user: Read the boiler through StokerCloud when the local network can't reach it. Find it in stokercloud.dk/v3/#/<user>/main-page.

data.use_open_meteo: Use Open-Meteo for climate, wind and sun

data_description.use_open_meteo: Sends your location rounded to ~1 km to open-meteo.com.

data.apply_calibration: Correct the controller's counter with the learned calibration

data_description.restock_date: When you plan to buy pellets again, e.g. when new-season prices start. Default 06-01.
data_description.order_lead_days: 'Order pellets' turns on when there is a 10% chance of running dry within this many days.
data_description.silo_sensor: A level sensor in percent, or a distance sensor above the pellets (then fill in the two readings below).

state.alarm_burner_plug: Alarm: burner plug or shaft sensor
state.alarm_no_flame_high: Alarm: no flame at high power
state.alarm_no_flame_low: Alarm: no flame at low power

state.residual_heat_to_dhw: Moving residual heat to hot water

runout_risk.name: Risk of running out before restock

alarm_out_of_pellets.title: {boiler}: probably out of pellets
alarm_out_of_pellets.description: The boiler raised an ignition alarm (code {code}) and the silo holds about {silo} kg. Fill the silo, then reset the alarm on the boiler or with the Reset alarm button.

alarm_ignition.title: {boiler}: ignition failed
alarm_ignition.description: Alarm code {code}. There are still about {silo} kg in the silo, so check for ash or clinker in the burner and that the igniter works.

alarm_burner_hot.title: {boiler}: burner too hot
alarm_burner_hot.description: Alarm code {code}. Check the auger and the shaft sensor before restarting: a hot burner can mean burn-back risk.

alarm_overheat.title: {boiler}: overheated
alarm_overheat.description: Alarm code {code}. The overheat thermostat tripped. Let the boiler cool and check that the pumps circulate, then reset the thermostat.

alarm_generic.title: {boiler}: alarm
alarm_generic.description: The boiler raised alarm code {code}. Check the boiler's display for details.

pin_required.message: Set the boiler's PIN in the integration to change settings.

pin_wrong.message: The boiler refused the PIN. Home Assistant will ask for a new one.

amount_required.message: Give an amount in kg or bags.

not_enough_storage.message: Only {storage} kg in storage, cannot take {kg} kg.

nothing_to_fill.message: Nothing to fill: storage is empty or the silo is full.

bad_fill_log.message: Could not read the fill log: {error}

empty_fill_log.message: The fill log has no lines.

entry_ambiguous.message: More than one boiler: say which with config_entry_id.
